suite: V2.4.4 — Google Play Purchase Lifecycle Hardening
note: Tests exercise actual imported handlers with mock Redis and Google API doubles. V2.4.4 adds 12 new suites covering: fail-closed RTDN authentication (503 when secret missing, timing-safe comparison), RTDN processing state machine (RECEIVED → PROCESSED with crash recovery), non-consumable restoration requiring purchase token and product ID cross-validation, atomic revocation with audit trail in single Lua script, and regression tests that fail when security guards are removed. Manual tests requiring Play Console, Cloud Pub/Sub, and RTDN configuration are documented but not run.
